registerNotes.intimate: तू is for very close friends and family. Practise this one with आप and तुम.

this-year.text: इस साल मैं ___ चाहता / चाहती हूँ
this-year.rom: is saal main ___ chaahtaa / chaahtee hoon

next-month.text: अगले महीने मैं ___ वाला / वाली हूँ
next-month.rom: agle maheene main ___ vaalaa / vaalee hoon

notes: The -ने वाला form says what you are going to do: मैं गोवा जाने वाला हूँ (a man), जाने वाली हूँ (a woman).
मुझे ... ना है says what you have to do: मुझे काम करना है, I have to work. It is the same for a man and a woman.
घूमना means to travel or wander for fun. In the summer holidays, many families head for the hills: शिमला, मनाली, मसूरी.
